extension.description: Browse, search, and export Antigravity AI conversation history with full reasoning chain, workspace categorization, and multi-format support.
config.language: Display language for Antigravity History UI and exports
config.exportFormat: Default export format (Markdown, JSON, or both)
config.fieldLevel: Export detail level: default (messages only), thinking (+ AI reasoning), full (+ diffs, outputs)
config.exportStrategy: Export organization strategy: workspace (group by conversation project), unified (single export folder)
config.singleExportMode: Single conversation export mode: Save Dialog or Direct Export
config.singleExportMode.dialog: Save Dialog (Prompt to choose directory and filename)
config.singleExportMode.direct: Direct Export (Silently save to default or project folder)
